errors.rationale: The denominator was incorrectly changed from 5 to 3. The correct denominator is $2 - (-3) = 5$, not 3. This error propagates to give the wrong final answer of $-\dfrac{10}{3}$ instead of $-2$.

The numerator was incorrectly computed as $5 - (-5) = 10$ instead of $-5 - 5 = -10$. The points were swapped so that $y_1 = -5$ and $y_2 = 5$ instead of the stated assignment, giving the opposite sign in the numerator.

The subtraction of a negative was incorrectly computed. Writing $2 + (-3)$ instead of $2 - (-3)$ gives $-1$ in the denominator rather than $5$, changing the slope calculation. This is a wrong operation applied to the denominator.
